definition: Aligning HR strategy, programs, and capabilities with business strategy to create and sustain competitive advantage.
An HR professional who acts as a trusted advisor to leadership, translating business goals into people strategy.
A structured approach to transitioning individuals, teams, and the organization through a change to achieve desired outcomes.
